title: Candy Craft
description: Transform your world into a sweet candy paradise! Chocolate stone, jelly logs, marshmallow snow and more.
body:
# 🍬 Candy Craft

> *Every block is a treat. Every biome is a dessert.*

**Candy Craft** turns the entire Minecraft world into a colorful candy wonderland.
Stone becomes chocolate, logs become jelly candy, snow becomes marshmallow, and water becomes sparkling soda!

---

## 🍫 Features

- **128 custom textures** covering all biomes
- **Chocolate** stone & cobblestone with snap-lines
- **Jelly candy logs** — each wood type has its own flavor color
- **Sprinkle planks** — pastel wood with candy sprinkles
- **Cotton candy leaves** — soft fluffy foliage
- **Marshmallow snow** & **bubblegum ice**
- **Sparkling soda water** with bubbles
- **Sugar sand** — fine pastel yellow grains
- **Lollipop log tops** — swirled ring pattern
- **Neon candy Nether** — psychedelic sweets in the underworld
- **Pastel pink GUI** — strawberry hotbar & cookie food icons
- **Purple moon** & **lemon sun**

---

## 🌍 Biome Themes

| Biome | Candy Theme |
|---|---|
| Forest / Oak | Strawberry jelly |
| Birch | Banana candy |
| Spruce | Blueberry |
| Dark Oak | Dark chocolate |
| Jungle | Lime jelly |
| Cherry Grove | Soft pink chocolate |
| Savanna | Orange candy |
| Desert | Sugar sand & shortbread |
| Snow / Tundra | Marshmallow & bubblegum ice |
| Swamp / Mangrove | Mint candy |
| Mushroom Island | Grape mycelium |
| Ocean | Soda water & colorful coral |
| Nether | Psychedelic neon candy |
| The End | Lemon & grape sweets |

---

## 📦 Installation

1. Download the `.zip` — **do not extract**
2. Drag & drop into **Options → Resource Packs**
3. Move to **Selected** and enjoy!

**Minecraft Java Edition 1.20.x** (pack_format 15) · **32×32 resolution**
